shared_elements: incised parallel/hatched line groups suggesting hair, beard or drapery
fragment of a human head or figure
justification: A shows a procession of full standing human figures in profile, repeated in a horizontal band with pleated robes and stepped beards, while B shows only a single small fragment whose incised cross-hatched and parallel grooves read as a stylised coiffure or beard on a head, so the only real correspondence is the convention of rendering hair/drapery as tight rows of parallel incisions. There is no shared scene, no shared arrangement of multiple elements, and B offers no figures, attributes or relationships to compare with A's ordered file of staff-bearing attendants.
